name: ContactChannelValidation

storage_validation: input must be string within bounds.json contact_channels.value_text pre-normalization bound
remove only leading/trailing code points from pinned UNICODE_MATCH_V1 White_Space set; do not otherwise rewrite operator value for storage
reject empty result, NUL, CR, LF, C0/C1 control characters and any second logical line
parse complete remaining value as exactly one addr-spec using Python stdlib email.headerregistry.Address(addr_spec=value); parsing failure is CHANNEL_INVALID
do not perform DNS, SMTP, network, mailbox-existence or deliverability checks
persist trimmed accepted value_text and compute match_key separately through UNICODE_MATCH_V1; matching key is evidence and does not replace address actually stored

specific_channel: Contact and selected channel must both be active
rerun EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 syntax validation just in time
return USABLE with value_text only after successful validation
auto_select: load only bounded identity/value projections for active email channels using indexed Contact-channel query
validate each candidate without network access
zero usable -> MISSING (or INVALID only when one explicitly selected channel is malformed)
more than one usable -> MULTIPLE_USABLE with exact usable_count plus bounded channel IDs/continuation; never choose one by row order
rules: do not contact DNS, SMTP or external email service
failure/ambiguity blocks only communication-dependent action and never invalidates Contact/Ticket/Task/Objective/Spare Need/Spare Request
a consuming workflow may bypass MULTIPLE_USABLE only if its own separately accepted contract names a deterministic eligible-channel selection rule

result.rule: MISSING/ARCHIVED/INVALID/MULTIPLE_USABLE are prerequisite states for recipient-requiring workflow, not reasons to invalidate underlying operational entity

determinism.rule: EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 accepted/rejected golden vectors must produce identical results on supported Python 3.13 and 3.14 lines
determinism.upgrade: if future supported Python/parser change alters an accepted golden vector, version channel policy or add explicit compatibility shim before release rather than silently changing stored-channel eligibility

security_rules: recipient values are data only and never interpolated into HTML, shell, SQL or header text without owning serializer escaping
CR/LF/control rejection prevents recipient-header injection through master channel value
AUTO_SELECT never treats SQL row order as business authority
LLD-09 generated artifact stores immutable recipient Contact identity and exact address snapshot effective at generation time
